title: 'Nzuddi
text:
'Nzuddi
'Nzuddi
'Nzuddi
are traditional
cookies
typical of the
Italian
provinces of
Messina
and
Catania
. They are spherical, slightly flattened, golden-colored cookies, made of flour, sugar, almonds, cinnamon, egg whites, and ammonia.
[
1
]
Historically, the cookies were made for the feast of Our Lady of the Letter, Saint Patron of the city of Messina, on June 3.
[
2
]
These cakes were originally prepared in the
monastery
of the Vincentian Sisters, and the name
'nzuddi
derives from the abbreviation of the name "Vincenzo" in the
Sicilian language
.

3
]
